I fixed the role guard, and all seven 2B tests now pass on seed 1. I’m extending the partial adapter with log, commit and application state so the new transitions are represented in the proof history.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > PROGRESS.md <<'EOF'
Round 2 chosen goal: leader_append_only, first dependency actual log proposal and AppendEntries mutations. Added shared executable log.rs with exact contracts for matches, propose, insert, commit_candidate and next_application, plus insertion_keeps_prefix. The runtime now owns the same log_core::Core that the partial proof adapter projects: election state, exact entry objects/command vectors, commit and applied cursors. Raft::start persists proposals before replication; RaftHandle::append_entries serializes, persists the actual merged log before reply/application; replicate correlates replies with requests and updates per-peer match/next indices; advance_commit checks majority and current term; apply emits consecutive commands. Election requests now carry actual last-log boundaries. Durable generations now include the complete log with term/vote via bincode.

Formal coverage: proof/segments.rs extends initialization/transitions with proposal, insertion, commit and application segments; proof/implementation.rs contains actual_initial, actual_proposal and actual_insert correspondence bodies using the real constructor/primitives. local_leader_append_only proves extension while the partial node remains leader in one term; this is a dependency, not the independent cluster target. The old fixed-support vote send/delivery/handler path is retained. Latest top execution_link passed at runs/checks/1793270025116367015. Complete cluster observations, AppendEntries batch provenance and handler-loop correspondence, authenticated vote/match counting, storage completion and crash/recovery correspondence remain OPEN. runtime_step describes only documented partial segments and does not cover all async execution.

Evidence: all 3 original 2A, all 7 original 2B and all 8 original 2C tests passed on every configured seed 1-5 on one source version (checks 1793269995627946799 through 1793270000896085876; see RESULT.md). Build passed before the Core extraction; subsequent Cargo test runs rebuilt and passed with the Core extraction. safety at runs/checks/1793269996641626505 passed foundation, definitions, partial execution_link and progress, but all five target callers, snapshot_observation, nonempty_execution and aggregate remained OPEN due missing interfaces. No successful cluster safety conclusion is claimed. A final extra local prefix lemma was added and verified after the functional sweep; it is proof-only.

Diagnostics/repairs: initial 2B run had 4 passes/3 failures because the new heartbeat throttle let an existing leader enter the timeout branch between heartbeats; added the missing follower/candidate role guard and all 2B cases passed. Existing basic_agree_2b/concurrent_starts_2b/fail_agree_2b tests are the regression checks. Refactoring initially failed Cargo because a named ghost-only fresh import disappears after erasure; replaced with a wildcard import and rechecked. A concurrent proof edit during one earlier passing test sweep caused its overall checker result to be INCOMPLETE; the later unchanged-source sweep passed. Round 1 append-journal approach had failed because File::open is read-only; alternating complete generations remains the chosen recovery approach, with proof OPEN.

Next formal obstacle: choose a genuine cluster state/history with stable group/node identities, emitted request/reply records, durable votes, distinct-peer acknowledgements and persistent completion phases; derive counts and observation events from that state rather than caller-supplied counts. Actual functions requiring caller proofs are send_vote_request, replicate, Raft::append_entries, advance_commit, apply, persist and restore. Next checks: python3 scripts/check.py top leader_append_only after exporting complete observe/proof interfaces, and python3 scripts/check.py top execution_link after every adapter expansion. Next runtime increment: coherent snapshot base/suffix representation and snapshot install/recovery, with fixed decoder/observation obligations developed alongside it. Snapshots and all application labs remain placeholders; checked exhaustion/invalid-boundary coverage, all five global goals and conditional liveness remain OPEN.
EOF
cat > RESULT.md <<'EOF'
Candidate remains incomplete. Raft election, replication, conflict repair, commitment/application and log persistence are implemented. Retained tests for 2A (3 tests), 2B (7 tests) and 2C (8 tests) pass for every configured seed 1-5. Snapshot tests and KV/controller/sharded-KV labs remain unfinished. No global Raft safety or complete executable correspondence claim is made.

Reproduce the functional sweep with python3 scripts/check.py test _2a --seed N, python3 scripts/check.py test _2b --seed N and python3 scripts/check.py test _2c --seed N for N in 1,2,3,4,5. Passing stopped-source results occupy runs/checks/1793269995627946799 through runs/checks/1793270000896085876. In seed order, 2B results are 1793269996021843290, 1793269997612947791, 1793269998805602956, 1793269999726679620 and 1793270000644563713; 2C results are 1793269996483974465, 1793269997889890657, 1793269999093341448, 1793269999958334976 and 1793270000896085876. A subsequent proof-only local prefix lemma does not alter executable decisions; its top execution_link check passed at 1793270025116367015.

The shared election/log primitives verify with python3 scripts/check.py proof madraft/proof/progress.rs. They include exact state effects, local single-vote preservation, insertion prefix preservation and checked application authorization. The partial adapter projects the real log_core::Core and has concrete initialization/proposal/insertion bodies. python3 scripts/check.py top execution_link verifies that partial unit. python3 scripts/check.py safety at 1793269996641626505 reports all five targets, observation/snapshot, nonempty observed witness and aggregate OPEN (missing interfaces); foundation, definitions, partial execution_link and progress pass. No finite test or local proof count establishes cluster safety or conditional liveness.

Persistence/recovery: alternating self-contained bincode images in state and snapshot contain generation, term, vote and complete log. The serial async mutex prevents concurrent writes; creating the inactive file preserves the other generation, and recovery chooses the highest complete decoded image. If files exist with no valid image, startup fails closed. Actual encoding/decoding, host-completion ordering, interrupted generation recovery and physical durability are still formal obligations. MadSim sync_all is a no-op and no real-disk power-loss guarantee is claimed. Snapshot application bytes, compaction boundaries, installation and service decoder fidelity are not yet implemented; snapshot currently names the second full consensus generation.

Host/TCB: net::Endpoint::{bind,add_rpc_handler,call_timeout}, task::spawn, Instant::now, sleep, random timeout generation, futures::lock::Mutex, std::sync::Mutex, mpsc delivery, fs::{read,File::create}, File::{write_all_at,sync_all}, and serde/bincode under the fixed environment contracts. Core protocol primitives are checked, but asynchronous RPC scheduling, distinct-peer tally loops, replication merge loops, cursor callers, persistence coordination and deployment identity mapping remain unproved rather than newly trusted consensus bodies. Proposals, valid/invalid RPCs, delayed responses and restart paths need complete cluster refinement; finite counter/resource bounds also remain OPEN.

Next steps are the cluster provenance/durable-vote invariant and observation interface, snapshot representation/decoder/recovery and all remaining labs. Use python3 scripts/check.py safety for composition feedback and python3 scripts/check.py final --timeout 3600 only when the remaining implementation and proof interfaces are complete. Original tests, requirements and check scripts were preserved; independent controller feedback determines acceptance.
EOF"

Saved code and updated `PROGRESS.md` and `RESULT.md`.

- All 18 retained 2A–2C tests pass on seeds 1–5.
- Shared election/log contracts and partial correspondence proofs pass Verus.
- Fixed a leader timer regression found by 2B tests.
